description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class `EmployeeContactDetailsAPI` for managing employee contact details within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving and updating contact details, as well as validation rules and email validation logic. The class is part of the PIM plugin API and adheres to RESTful principles, providing OpenAPI annotations for documentation.
